definitions.actual_torque: Recorded post-step applied effort for the preceding 5 ms substep; initial t0 cached/reset effort excluded
definitions.leg_target_rate: diff(actual clipped leg action)/.02 in rad/s because q_target=q0+action and q0 is constant; not measured joint velocity
definitions.wheel_action_rate: diff(actual clipped wheel action)/.02 in normalized units/s; not wheel angular acceleration
definitions.wheel_requested_torque: 12*actual clipped wheel action at 50 Hz, before motor speed-dependent clipping; recorded actual torque is authoritative
definitions.burden_window: Commands issued in [start,end), their post-step torques in (start,end]; core 128 commands/512 torques, full 349/1396
definitions.rate_boundary: Differences between actual successive issued commands; no invented t0 delta; full 348 rates, core 128 including its preceding-command boundary change
definitions.canonical_metrics: Copied unchanged from hash-bound public pairs; closed 1.44–4.00 s window has 513 physical samples, distinct from aligned burden window
definitions.group_l2: Per-time norm over six leg or two wheel components, then RMS/p95/peak; pooled-component quantiles flatten all samples/components

not_computed: power, work, energy or battery consumption
limitations: One seed and one nominal episode per engine/controller; not an algorithm ranking or causal explanation.
SAC MuJoCo includes fallen/posture-failure states; effort is not conditional on successful tracking.
PPO/SAC actor sees 51 inputs; NMPC has full physical/contact state and future preview; matched stage terms do not equalize discount/termination/normalization or compute.
NMPC source versions and host-specific native builds differ across development cases; canonical provenance is preserved, not relabeled.
Lower effort/action variation alone does not establish better control or successful speed-retaining turning; no numerical speed/posture/height/beta gate is added.
